notes.title: Patch - 12/23/2020
notes.content:
[h2]Tutorial Beta 2.0[/h2]
We've been working on a new tutorial that can teach the game's basics to players who never played Artifact 1 (or any other card game, for that matter).  We're shipping an early version of this tutorial out to our existing players so you can try it over the holidays.  Like everything else in Artifact 2.0 Beta, we approached the tutorial's gameplay before anything else, so the visuals and fictionalization are rough and unfinished.  This set of missions don't need to teach everything; just the basics.  Other topics will be covered by standalone advanced tutorials, which function more like the Hero Card Demos.
 
We'd love you to give the new tutorial a spin and send us feedback at ArtifactBetaFeedback@valvesoftware.com.

[h2]Item Experiment[/h2]
We’re experimenting with item-equipping rules that are somewhat simplified, and in some ways more open and in other ways more restrictive. We’d like to figure out how much the 3 different types of item slots are really buying us, so we’re trying out a system that gets rid of them.  Instead, heroes can equip any two (unique) items, no worrying about if it’s a weapon or accessory or armor. If you already have two items equipped and want to equip a new one, you get to choose which one to bounce by dragging directly onto that item.

Along with this experiment you’ll get a partial sneak-peek at where we’re going with the visual design of the cards themselves, getting rid of the battle sleeve on top. It’s a [i]franken-card[/i] right now, but a bit simpler visually already, with status effects no longer blocking much of the card art, and without empty item slots taking up a lot of visual space.

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]

[b]Heroes[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Lycan[/b]'s [i]Pack Leadership[/i] does not count disarmed creeps.
[*] [b]Kanna[/b]'s [i]Diabolic Conclusion[/i] no longer disarms creeps that cast it (i.e. Terrapin Channeler). It also only draws Attack from units that are not disarmed.
[/list]

When a card’s faction is changed, it now changes many faction-related effects the card has to match the new faction. This brings it in line with how color-changing cards work (e.g. if you change a [i]Rebel Rabble Rouser[/i] to blue, it starts creating blue [i]Roused Rabble[/i]s – now if you change its faction to [u]Bronze Legion[/u] it starts creating [u]Bronze Legion[/u] [i]Roused Rabble[/i]s.)

[b]Creeps[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Greevil Bronco[/i] applies its effects to its faction allies if you change its faction.
[*] [i]Greevil Eggtender[/i] still adds in 3 random [u]Greevil[/u]s, but changes the one you draw to the Eggtender’s faction.
[*] [i]Imperial Herald[/i] gives faction allies +1 Attack and +1 Armor if you change its faction before playing it.
[*] [i]Legion Scouting Party[/i] adds a [i]Bronze Legionnaire[/i] of the [i]Legion Scouting Party[/i]'s color and faction, but draws a faction allied creep if it changes factions.
[*] [i]Oglodi Vandal[/i]'s Play Effect changed to: Each [u]Red Mist[/u] ally deals 1 damage to the enemy tower. This also changes relative to its faction.
[*] [i]Rebel Rabble Rouser[/i] changes [i]Roused Rabble[/i] to [i]Rebel Rabble Rouser[/i]’s color and faction. 
[*] [i]Roused Rabble[/i] gains buffs based on its current faction allies.
[*] [i]Rebel Recruiter[/i] now checks if its faction allies take damage, then draws and reveals a creep from the opponent’s deck. It changes to [i]Rebel Recruiter[/i]’s faction and color.
[*] [i]Spirited Greevil[/i] applies its effects to its faction allies if you change its faction.
[*] [i]Spitting Greevil[/i] applies its effects to its faction allies if you change its faction.
[*] [i]Thieving Greevil[/i] applies its effects to its faction allies if you change its faction.
[*] [i]Vhoul Elder[/i] now checks if its faction allies take damage, then reduces costs and buffs creeps.
[*] The following creeps also join the [u]Red Mist[/u]: [i]Horde Stryder[/i], [i]Oglodi Catapult[/i], [i]Red Mist Pillager[/i], and [i]Untested Grunt[/i].
[/list]

[b]Spells[/b]
[list]
[*] [i]Better Late than Never[/i] summons a [i]Terrapin Channeler[/i] of the caster's color.
[*] [i]Shifting Loyalties[/i] now swaps factions of the creeps it swaps control of.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Items now show up on the face of the card rather than in item slots on the battle sleeve. When you equip an item, if you have an empty slot you can still drag it to the hero, but you can also drag it directly onto a slot (which will show up when you start to drag).
[*] When equipping items, heroes now come forward from the board, closer to the camera, to assist in directly targeting item slots.
[/list]

[h2]Hero Demos[/h2]
[list]
[*] Hero demos got their own end game screen that lets you retry the demo. It will later be filled out with a flavorful description of the hero and the demo.
[*] Added hero demos for [b]Lina[/b], [b]Luna[/b], [b]J'Muy[/b], and [b]Imperia[/b].
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed damage tooltip summary not applying Decay values.
[*] Fixed unexpected results of Decay. Previously, Decay could kill a unit during battle despite the effects of Regeneration. The results should now match the combat preview.
[*] Fixed [i]Greevil Eggtender[/i] only adding one color of [u]Greevil[/u] added to the deck. Now you can get up to three differently colored [u]Greevil[/u]s.
[*] Fixed [i]Volatile Fog[/i] leaving [b]Earthshaker[/b]'s [i]Rock[/i]s around after the combat phase ends.
[*] Fixed [i]Relentless Pursuit[/i] causing a crash when striking a unit with retaliate.
[/list]

notes.title: State of the Beta
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37947562/a24a0f32240b3fbedb326fea44d943a255d34fa1.png[/img]

We've been trying a ton of different things with game design over the past year or so, and have been developing and testing the game in public since April. Everything has been in flux. As the design has begun to settle down some, we're ready to enter the tightening phase: teaching the game, polishing the game, and completing game features, eventually all leading up to a push to grow the game. And since it’s the end of the calendar year, we thought it’d be a good time to do a quick recap of where we’ve been and where we are, and to lay out our plans for where we’re going. 

[h1]A quick recap of the beta so far.[/h1]
[list]
[*] Started developing and testing the game in public in April.
[*] Invited player waves and iterated on the biggest pain points discovered with each wave.
[*] Iterated on hero design and item design in conjunction with waves and community discussion.
[*] Increased the strength and impact of heroes across the board.
[*] Made several passes on card design to make more cards relevant and improve gameplay.
[*] Added ranked play.
[*] Added hero demo puzzles.
[*] Added various UI components to better convey the game state (status effect icons, glossary fly-outs).
[*] Experimented with shop rules and simplified shop UI.
[*] Experimented with multicolor cards.
[*] Experimented with factions.
[*] Experimented with multicolor casting rules.
[/list]

[h1]Where are we going? (AKA: Open beta when?)[/h1]

There are still quite a few things we feel need to be in place before we’re ready to enter a major growth phase of the game. We will need to invite new players before then to test whenever we add something new, but the aim will still be testing things, rather than inviting players with the goal of growing the player base just yet. 

We don’t want to enter any major growth push until the game is ready for a wide range of players to consume without bouncing off of it. Additionally, we want to be in a place internally where we no longer have catch-up work to do on the main game experience and can shift our focus more towards new content as soon as open beta starts.

[b]Players should have a clear way to learn to play the game. [/b]
[list]
[*] In-game tutorial to teach the basics.
[*] Hero card demo puzzles to teach individual cards.
[*] Informative UI and effects.
[/list]

[b]Learning game strategy should be fun and players should have a long runway available before being thrown in the shark tank. [/b]
[list]
[*] Improved bot play to make playing against bots more meaningful.
[*] More single player missions and a system for regularly adding more missions.
[*] Progression for playing with friends, incentives to invite friends and play with friends.
[*] Progression for playing vs bots, not just ranked.
[*] Clearer unlocking progression for hero draft.
[/list] 

[b]Gameplay should be relatively stable and not constantly changing as players are trying to learn the game.
[/b]
[list]
[*] We should largely be done with large game-changing rules experiments. 
[*] This doesn’t mean we’d ever stop changing cards, but that we should get to a point where it’s less frequent, and more often bundled together in larger patches.
[/list]

[b]More game modes to bridge the gap between the relatively lighter experience of hero draft and the heavier experience of constructed.
[/b]
[list]
[*] Advanced hero draft is the most likely candidate.
[*] Ephemeral events so that we can add temporary game modes to focus the player base.
[*] Focused playtest events.
[/list]

[b]The game should be both functional and fun to look at.[/b]
[list]
[*] Final card art.
[*] Beautiful animations and effects.
[*] Beautiful board.
[*] Effects that serve a functional purpose, conveying what the cards are doing and the resulting game state.
[/list]

[h1]Alright, alright...  So what’s the roadmap then?[/h1]

We’re getting ready to ship Tutorial Beta 2.0 to existing players [b]early next week[/b]. We’d like to test it with the current player base first for [b]a few weeks[/b] before trying with new players. Once we’ve got our first round of feedback we’d like to start inviting small waves of new players who signed up for the beta but hadn't played 1.0 while we iterate on teaching the game.

Sometime [b]in mid-to-late January[/b] we’d like to start letting players invite their friends as our main way of inviting new players while we continue to iterate on all the above goals. We expect we are a [b]few months away[/b] from slowing down constant changes to cards, game rules, and balance. [b]At that point[/b] we expect to spend more of our effort on UI, UX, and all the many features listed above on the road to open beta and eventual release. 

We expect release (with open beta and a growth push happening shortly before then) is [b]far enough away[/b] that it would be a disservice to try to pin down a date right now. We know what we need to do before then, but for now it’s still one foot in front of the other until the game is ready for it.

[h1]And now, for a glimpse of the future.[/h1]

A picture is worth a thousand words, so here's [strike]a thousand[/strike] twenty pictures looking to the future, some concept art and some card art hot off the presses.

notes.title: Patch - 10/29/2020
notes.content:
[h1]Experimental Rules: Multicolor Casting[/h1]

We’re experimenting with a rule change: Heroes now enable other heroes in their lane to cast cards of their color. So if you have a red hero and a blue hero in a lane, for example, the blue hero can cast red spells and the red hero can cast blue spells. This should reduce the disadvantage multicolor decks have as compared to monocolor decks with regards to targeted stuns and silences, as well as reduce the disadvantage multicolor decks get when casting certain “caster”-related cards and enable a number of new interactions for multicolor decks.

[h1]Game Demos[/h1]

A fiendishly difficult puzzle has been added as [b]Kanna[/b]’s card demo. Spooky!

The existing demos for the red heroes ([b]Axe[/b], [b]Beastmaster[/b], [b]Bristleback[/b], [b]Centaur Warrunner[/b], [b]Keefe the Bold[/b], [b]Legion Commander[/b], [b]Mazzie[/b], and [b]Magnus[/b]) have all been updated to be slightly more puzzle-y. Each of these demos has a "correct" play that leads to instant victory, some more obvious than others. You can lose some of them, others will just take you an extra turn to win if you don't find the optimal play.

Demos have been added for [b]Abaddon[/b], [b]Chen[/b], [b]Dark Seer[/b], [b]Lady Anshu[/b], [b]Rix[/b], [b]Tiny[/b], [b]Underlord[/b], and [b]Wraith King[/b].

[h1]Shop v2.1[/h1]

Shop mechanics, item costs, and the shop UI have all been reworked. 

The base cost of each item Tier goes up by 10 rather than 5. Mid-tier costs have also been added, so Tier 1 items can cost either 10 or 15 gold, Tier 2 items can cost either 20 or 25 gold, up to Tier 5 items costing the maximum 50 gold.

Upgrading the shop no longer costs any gold, skipping shopping gives you 5 gold (and does not increase with shop level), and you start the game with 10 gold rather than 5 gold. Also, towers no longer reward 10 gold when killed.

In constructed, no random items are added to your deck. It's just your item deck, though you will get random tier 1 items offered if you run out of items from your item deck.

The rules for the shop slots have been simplified slightly as well. The left slot is an item from the highest tier available and the right slot is an item from the lowest tier available (previously it was any item you can afford) and item costs can no longer increase as you scan from the left to the right slot.

notes.title: The Results Are In
notes.content:
[b]Item Survey[/b]
 
The results are in for the second item survey!  The biggest losers were Hero’s Cape, Guardian Greaves, Holy Locket, Spirit Vessel, Vladimir’s Offering, and Radiance.  Aside from Radiance, these items all have a very heavy protective angle that sometimes overshadows their other value, and they mostly don’t seem worth their gold cost overall. It seems like they could all be tweaked a bit to push their various specialties and blend less into the pack of items that keep you alive but don’t do much else. Radiance seems like it just doesn’t do enough for a 30 gold item, and should be made to have a more immediate and more intimidating presence when equipped. 

The big winners were Sorla Khan’s Spear, Vesture of the Tyrant, and all the 30 gold items aside from Radiance.  Vesture of the Tyrant is notable for being a big winner and a big loser simultaneously, as it was voted least fun to play against by a significant margin – it’s probably just in the wrong tier.
 
[b]Roadmap and Priorities[/b]

Each time we invite a new wave of players, we receive a new wave of feedback. Sometimes we learn that we’ve successfully addressed a problem commonly reported in previous waves, other times we learn that there’s more that remains to be done to truly fix it. As we’ve been fixing bugs, for example,  the feedback about specific card interactions not working as expected has died down a bit. There’s still a good amount of work left to do there, but things have gotten less chaotic. 

However there are two pieces of feedback that we continue to receive with each new wave, and which have become our top priorities:

[list]
[*] Learning the definition of a keyword, or what a card in your hand is going to do, is challenging and sometimes impossible. 
[*] We’re hearing from players that a fully-functioning tutorial (one that is more than a starter campaign) is highly desirable. 
[/list]

We are taking a two-pronged approach to the beta, which means that in addition to our primary focus of on-ramping new players, we’re hoping to also find ways to prioritize players already in the beta. We’d like to start adding in more of the game modes we have planned, especially for those happy playing with the current level of polish but looking for something meatier than hero draft. How would you like us to prioritize our focus for experienced players? Send us an email at ArtifactBetaFeedback@valvesoftware.com or use the in-game reporting tool to tell us what you would like to see first:

[list]
[*] A full-deck draft mode, similar to 1.0
[*] A ranked constructed queue
[*] An advanced hero draft mode that is somewhere in-between hero draft and full-deck draft
[*] A tournament system
[*] Something else?
[/list]
 
As always, we look forward to hearing from you as we work together on making Artifact the best it can be!

[*]Added an explanation of how the different shop slots work to the shop upgrade tooltip.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed issues with not being able to spectate games.
[*]Skipping past the initial deployment phase in replays removes lane darkening effects.
[*]Fixed skipping the shopping phase if in the previous phase the player double clicked the coin or pressed spacebar on a keyboard with a high repeat rate.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 7/3/2020
notes.content:
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Added ability to choose between Constructed, Live Draft, or Random 2 Color game modes when playing against a bot.
[*]Removed the player level display from in game and match history in anticipation of it being replaced with player rank.
[*]Removed unused time remaining display from match history entries.
[*]Added an explicit option to cancel joining the constructed channel.
[*]Player level, experience, and rank now update in the player profile after each match.
[*]Health tooltip no longer shows an Armor duration error.
[/list]	

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where the –novid command line argument blocked reward popups.
[*]The Skip Startup Movies settings option now skips the opening splash screen.
[*]Fixed the layout on the feedback submission tool.
[*]The badge in your profile now correctly shows your Steam avatar.
[*]Match IDs now correctly display on the post-game stats screen.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a warning if you target your own units with Laguna Blade.
[*]Saphire Archon and Expose the Truth now ignore all item cards, not just Blink Scrolls.
[*]Lucent Beam adds a charge to Eclipse cards in the overdraw pile.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 7/1/2020
notes.content:
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a regression that was causing combat stats to no longer get locked if there were triggered events in a lane that resolved prior.
[*]Fixed Regeneration not being able to save units from dying in combat.
[*]Spiked Carapace again stuns the source of damage.
[*]Spiked Carapace no longer stuns the caster if they take Decay damage.
[*]When No Hesitation is cast, After Combat effects (such as Stonehall Cloak) can no longer save units that would die otherwise.
[*]Winter Wyvern and Timbersaw no longer trigger “enter lane” effects when moving within the lane (such as Glyph of Confusion).
[*]Fixed bounced heroes being re-deployed without their item stats applied.
[*]Fixed some cases where bounced units could take damage while at the fountain.
[*]Fixed another bug where combat previews wouldn’t display for heroes deployed by a card (Back for More, Hymn of St. Crella, Team Fight).
[*]Fixed some cases where the Press to Win button was shown incorrectly.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 6/26/2020
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Matchmaking now prefers not to match you with your previous opponent, although it can happen if you're searching long enough.[/list]

[b]Card Text[/b]
[list][*]Most cards with a condition are now written in "Condition, Action" ordering.
[*]Standardized some terminology when referring to distance and positions.
[*]Many small fixes.[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Blink Scrolls are now awarded on tower destruction by default rather than at half health.
[*]Fixed a bug where Spell Steal copying a card whose mana cost had been changed would result in a card with the wrong mana cost in your hand.
[*]Repeatable spells (Culling Blade, Death Pulse, and cards copied by Multicast) now only trigger "card played" effects on the first copy and not when repeated.
[*]Couriers are no longer tower enchantments, don't trigger "card played" abilities, and can't be stolen by Spell Steal or Void Theft, bringing them closer in-line to the expected eventual functionality (just a game rule). 
[*]Multicast now resolves before your hand refills from overdraw.
[*]Coup de Grace now discards a random non-item card rather than any card.
[*]Doppelganger renamed to Homunculus.
[*]Removed +2 attack bonus on Arclight Elemental.
[*]Rend Armor has been removed from the set.
[*]Helm of the Dominator: 
Cost 20 -> 25
[*]Rubick:
Telekinesis now is crosslane for the pickup and the drop.
Unlock order 1 -> 4
[*]Tidehunter: 
Ravage cooldown 5 -> 4
[*]Beastmaster:
Stats 3/7 -> 3/6[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list][*]Units deployed by card effects like Back For More now show the correct combat previews.
[*]Fixed a bug preventing players from automatically passing after timing out in the hero ordering draft phase.
[*]Fixed human names sometimes being displayed as Bot.
[*]Combat preview no longer expects units that die to quickstrike to live long enough to regenerate.
[*]Bristleback is no longer triggered by Exsanguinate.[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 6/23/2020
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*] Multicasting a color swapped card now gives you a card of that color, rather than the card's base color.
[*] Aghanim's Sanctum now shows whether or not it has been used this turn.
[*] Repeatable spells, Spell Steal, and Void Theft no longer use overdraw.[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list][*] Hero death effects, such as Lady Anshu's Devoted Disciple passive, no longer trigger when the hero is being replaced in the deployment phase.
[*] Summoned token units, such as Horn of the Alpha's Thunderhide Pack, now devour other units in The Hunger.
[*] Fixed a bug where Meepo would occasionally not animate to the correct combat position during Poof.
[*] The Tyler Estate no longer triggers itself when played.
[*] Fixed right clicking on avatar image in chat causing chat to scroll up.
[*] Fixed a crash caused by Dark Rift moving to an empty lane.
[*] Fixed a crash on Mac.[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 6/22/2020
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list][*]Tightened matchmaking parameters.
[*]The player’s deck in “Oops! All Meepos” has been retuned.
[*]Glossary tweaks based on feedback.[/list]

[b]Card Text[/b]
[list][*]Watchtower now correctly specifies that it triggers from your opponent's spells and enchantments.
[*]Clarified wording wording on Dragon Tail. The stun and damage apply to the same adjacent enemy.[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list][*]Vanessa has a new passive ability: 
Overcharged Artificer
Equipped items give Vanessa +1 to the relevant attribute. 
Items equipped by Vanessa have a maximum of 1 cooldown.
[*]Rubick’s Spell Steal changed to
Blue 1
Put a copy of the last non-item card your opponent played into your hand. That card is blue, ephemeral, and costs 1 less.
Quickcast
[*]Rubick’s Telekinesis changed to
Swap an enemy to another position up to three slots away.
Cross Lane
Quickcast
[*]Pierpont has a new passive ability:
Expose the Truth
Pierce
Pierpont has +1 Attack per revealed card in opponent's hand.
[*]Meepos that die to Soulbound in the combat phase no longer die until all 3 lanes resolve.
[*]Wraithfire Blast can no longer target friendly units.
[*]Watchtower no longer makes the cards generated ignore the lane the caster is in.[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list][*]The timer no longer shows just before going to the shopping phase.
[*]The Hunger should (once again) be locked unless you’ve beaten the starter campaign.
[*]The maximum number of enchantments per tower is now 5, matching the visual display.[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 6/19/2020
notes.content:
[b]Hero Draft[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed hero draft deck generation algorithm so that each color has a weighting for roughly how many creeps, enchantments, and spells should be added to the randomized portion of the deck; for example blue heroes will tend to bring more spells or enchantments while green heroes will tend to bring more creeps.
[*]The number of cards of each color in hero draft decks is now strictly proportional to the color distribution of your heroes. For instance, running 2 red and 3 green heroes will yield a 14 red and 21 green card deck, including hero signature cards.
[/list]

[b]Campaign[/b]
[list]
[*]Rebalanced Mission 10 (Roseleaf) in the campaign.
[*]Added a new standalone PvE challenge:
“Oops! All Meepos”
Meepos are like cockroaches. If you see one you know you have an infestation on your hands.  All heroes in the player’s deck are Meepo.
[/list]

[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a visible timer to deployment and shopping phases. 
[*]Reduced timer lengths for deployment and shopping phases. They were very long because no visuals were hooked up yet.
[*]Added a disconnection timer. If a player loses connection they are given 3 minutes to reconnect and then they lose the game. Slowly regrows back to 3 minutes after they reconnect.
[*]Improved bot deployment decisions. The bot thought it was playing 1.0 during hero deployment and has been informed that it is now playing beta 2.0.
[*]Fixed some players receiving duplicate heroes.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Blink Scroll settings to private lobby. Supports rewarding them at half tower health, tower 
destruction, or not at all.
[*]Card Collection text search results now include referenced cards.
[/list]

[b]Card Text[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed misleading text that stated Kanna’s Bringer of Conquest ability was an After Combat effect. It has no interaction with Fractured Timeline.
[*]Changed Lina’s Fiery Soul to clarify that it triggers from the first plays in her lane, not “this” lane. If she changes lanes after triggering the effect, it can’t be triggered again until off cooldown.
[/list]

[b]Gameplay[/b]
[list]
[*]Sven's unlock order increased from 0  to 1.
[*]Legion Commander's unlock order decreased from 1 to 0.
[*]Color-swapped Arc Warden makes color-matched clones.
[*]Spell Steal copies charges from the stolen card, previously it only made a base copy.
[*]Meepo's Poof now targets empty positions (or its own) instead of by lane.
[*]Vendetta now only moves to a blocked combat position and updates state based effects between moving and sneak attacking.
[*]Ravenhook now can target any enemy hero in lane, rather than just adjacent heroes.
[*]Abilities that trigger when damage is dealt no longer trigger if the damage is fully prevented. Think Ursa / Clear the Deck / Iron Sharpens Iron vs Unbreakable Column or Damage Immunity. They do still trigger if the damage is not prevented but is dealt to armor.
[*]Fractured Timeline no longer stops Earthshaker's Rocks from dying.
[*]Aftershock affects the lane instead of adjacent enemies.
[*]Conspiracy of Ravens now triggers on unit kill.
[*]Creeps bounced by Doppelganger now go to the hand with 1 Lock.
[*]Overpower is no longer able to damage towers.
[*]In lanes 1 & 3 on the opening flop, you may now deploy into any of the 5 positions rather than just the middle 3.
[*]The Omexe Arena changed to
Red 3
Enchant Tower
Aura: Allied heroes in the center slot have rapid deployment.
Unlock Order: 1
[*] Watchtower changed to
Blue 2
Enchant Tower
Play Effect: Copy a random card from your deck. It is blue, ephemeral, and can only be played from this lane.
When your opponent plays a non-item card in this lane, repeat this effect.
Unlock Order: 2
[*]Veteran’s Insight changed to
Red 3
Tower Enchantment
Aura: Allies randomly gain +1  Attack, Armor, or Health after dealing battle damage.
[*]Added card
In Full Bloom
Green 4
Tower enchantment
Mulch
Round Start: Give Allied units +1 temporary health.
[*]Added card
Plague Hex
Black 3
Tower enchantment
Aura: Allied units in this lane have “Death effect: Give a random surviving enemy unit +1 Decay until their next combat.”
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where chat was disabled in constructed games.
[*]The level up notification now shows your correct level.
[*]Fixed a bug where some keyboard inputs would unintentionally make you pass your turn.
[*]Spring the Trap only plays effects for Centaur Poachers that get summoned into the lane.
[*]Playing an additional No Hesitation in a lane initiates full combat and After Combat effects, not just the After Combat effects.
[*]Overpower no longer crashes the game if the caster dies mid-resolution (e.g. taking lethal retaliate damage).
[*]If a Doppelganger bounces a rooted unit, the unit now in fact bounces, rather than both sticking around in the same spot.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 6/12/2020
notes.content:
[b]General[/b]
[list]
[*]Tightened matchmaking parameters to prevent severely imbalanced matches. This is a stop-gap measure until player rank levels are more fully integrated.
[*]Made 1.5 cards per turn the default in hero draft.
[*]Players now unlock one early complexity tier 2 hero in their third pack, and an early complexity tier 3 hero in their tenth pack.
[*]Combat stats are now locked in before combat resolves; Drow dying early doesn’t change the result of later lanes, and Bloodseeker’s passive doesn’t change his stats mid-combat.
[*]Press to Win button now takes lane resolution order into account.
[*]Cards that deploy heroes now do Deploy effects.
[/list]

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Added constructed matchmaking chat channel which allows you to challenge users in the channel without being friends with them. The main menu now contains a button to join the channel.
[*]Chat now respects Steam community bans.
[*]Removed in-game chat. Bubble chat boxes on towers/units are still allowed.
[*]Rainbow Magic will now show a tick on the campaign map when completed.
[*]Fixed deck builder not indicating if you’ve built a deck that isn’t legal for constructed.
[*]Dragon Knight no longer puts a tower enchantment into play when damaging a tower in Dragon Form; instead you will see fumes on the tower to indicate the Decay is still active.
[/list]

[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]Color-shifted cards make cards of the new color. For instance, the card created by a blue Culling Blade will also be blue.
[*]Attempting to bounce rooted units no longer breaks the game.
[*]Retaliate border shows up again under normal arrow conditions.
[*]Timber Chain no longer damages multiple enemies en route to another lane when Timbersaw is rooted.
[*]Each Homefield Advantage disarms a different unit when stacked in the same lane.
[*]Eartshaker's Rocks no longer trigger death effects.
[*]Mjolnir only triggers when the hero can attack.
[*]Fixed a bug where equipping items could trigger Aghanim’s Sanctum or The Tyler Estate in another lane.
[*]Pressing to win no longer gives out Blink Scrolls.
[*]Fixed a bug where Sheep Stick could target friendly units.
[/list]

[b]Card Text[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Root to the glossary.
[*]Clarified Quickstrike in the glossary; only works in the combat phase.
[*]Clarified Summon in the glossary.
[*]Effects that replace melee creep now state that they are summoned rather than deployed.
[*]Vendetta now specifies that it works cross lane.
[*]Play Effect glossary entry updated to include non-creep cards.
[*]Arctic Burn now specifies that it works cross lane.
[/list]

[b]Balance[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased Body Modifications unlock tier: 1 -> 3.
[*]Decreased Bracers of Sacrifice damage 5 -> 4.
[*]Changed Essence Font from a Unit Enchantment to a Caster Enchantment and restricted its refund effect to spells and abilities cast in its lane.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 6/9/2020
notes.content:
Here are today's changes.

[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Triggered abilities that only trigger once per round (Crystal Maiden, Tidehunter) or once per two rounds (Ogre Magi) now show a cooldown number.
[*]Glossary clarification for Quickstrike: It only works in the combat phase.

notes.title: Patch 6/5/2020
notes.content:
Welcome new testers to the Artifact Beta 2.0!

If you are new to the Beta you should find Artifact Beta 2.0 ready to be installed in your Steam Library.

Here are today's changes.

[b]UI[/b]
[list][*]New Deployment buttons.
[*]Fixed a bug where displayed player ranks capped at Herald 3.

notes.title: Patch - 6/3/2020
notes.content:
Welcome new testers to the Artifact Beta 2.0!

If you are new to the Beta you should find Artifact Beta 2.0 ready to be installed in your Steam Library.

Here are today's changes.

[list][*] Added a temporary effect to visualize the in-game timer.

notes.title: Patch - 6/1/2020
notes.content:
Welcome new testers to the Artifact Beta 2.0!

If you are new to the Beta you should find Artifact Beta 2.0 ready to be installed in your Steam Library.

Here are the changes.

[h1]Campaign[/h1]

Campaign mission 5 (Quickly by the Old Road) has been rebalanced - two heroes in the player's deck were changed and a few new spells were added.

[h1]UI[/h1]

[list][*] Moved the in-game chat window from the bottom left of the screen to the top left.
[*] A river has been added to the center of the board; its flow direction indicates the lane order for combat resolution.
[*] A visual effect now plays when Schemes are triggered.
[*] Pressing ESC in the main UI no longer browses backwards in your navigation history, but instead returns to next screen up in the menu heirarchy.
[*] Arc Warden now has a hero icon.
[*] Removed unused skill rating display from match history entries.
[*] Clarified glossary entries for bounce and cleave.
[*] Added Blocked to the glossary.[/list]

[h1]Bugs[/h1]

[list][*] Fixed crash during a card inspection on Macs.
[*] Prevented clicks on mission dialogs from going through to the campaign map.
[*] Fixed an issue where no new heroes would be unlocked for several of the initial packs.
[*] Fixed an issue where players would never get matched against another player and couldn't play in private lobbies if their nearest datacenter was Singapore. (Please let us know if anyone else is experiencing this problem.)[/list]

[h1]Heroes[/h1]

Added first stab (or impale!) at Nyx Assassin.

[b]Legion Commander[/b]
Stats changed 4/1/4 -> 5/1/4.
Legion Commander's Moment of Courage only applies when she attacks. Heal 2 -> Heal 3.

[b]Sand King[/b]
Burrowstrike movement up from 4 to 5.

[b]Underlord[/b]
Dark Rift no longer tries to move more heroes to its target lane than will fit there.

[h1]Creeps / Spells[/h1]

[b]Animated Armor[/b]
Now puts a *locked* Artificer's Mail into your hand when it dies.

[b]Assassin's Apprentice[/b]
Now has Quickstrike all the time, not just for one battle.

[b]Assassin's Shadow [/b]
Now has Quickstrike all the time, not just for one battle.

[b]Corrosive Mist[/b]
Increased mana cost 5 -> 6.

[b]Courier[/b]
Now reduces the mana cost of items instead of refunding it.

[b]Lashvine Creeper[/b]
Now grabs the closest enemy, rather than a random enemy.

[b]Mist of Avernus[/b]
Reduced mana cost 4 -> 3.

[b]Path of the Bold[/b]
Starts with 0 charges.

[b]Path of the Cunning[/b]
Starts with 0 charges.

[b]Ravenous Mass[/b]
Now moves to adjacent enemies of your choice and devours them, rather than just devouring them and staying place.

[b]Temple of War[/b]
Card inspect shows the basic items.

[h1]Items[/h1]

[b]Blade of the Vigil[/b]
Attack +2 -> Attack +0.
Cleave +3 -> Cleave +4.

[b]Claszureme Hourglass[/b]
No longer interacts with forced card draw, it only locks extra cards drawn by sources the opponent controls. No more interaction with Imperia or an opponent's Howling Mind.

[b]Cloak of Endless Carnage[/b]
Now only draws one card per turn.

[b]Golden Ticket[/b]
Card drawn is now limited to your shop level or below.

Have Fun!
The Artifact Team
